title: Incorrect check for envvar in help rendering
detail: The condition `if not envvar:` is true for None, empty string, and empty list, causing the code to incorrectly add an empty or None envvar to the help output.
note: Says the branch runs on an empty or missing envvar, which the planted `not` does.

title: Auto envvar applied to empty envvar
detail: The condition `if not envvar` treats an empty string or empty list as falsy, causing the code to generate an automatic environment variable name even when the user explicitly set `envvar` to an empty value. This violates the intended behavior that an empty `envvar` should be treated as no envvar and should not trigger auto envvar logic.
note: About the auto-envvar assignment above the planted line; the PR's own logic.

title: Incorrect header name handling
detail: The loop sets `name = "Content-Type"` whenever the header key is not exactly "content-type" (case-insensitive). This causes every custom header to be overwritten as "Content-Type", losing the original header name and value. The client will send only a single Content-Type header, potentially dropping important headers.
note: Describes the planted flip: every other header is renamed to Content-Type.

title: Assumes Content-Type header exists
detail: The code accesses `self.headers["Content-Type"]` without checking its presence. If a caller omits the Content-Type header, a KeyError will be raised, crashing the request. The client should default to UTF-8 or handle missing header gracefully.
note: The client sets a Content-Type header when it's created.

title: Incorrect header normalization
detail: The logic sets every header name to "Content-Type" when the original name is not "content-type", overriding legitimate header names. This can silently drop or overwrite headers such as "User-Agent" or custom headers.

title: Exception instantiation ignores original exception
detail: The code creates a new exception instance without passing the original exception (`value`) to it, which loses the original error information and can lead to incorrect exception handling in the context manager.
note: Says the given exception is lost, which the flip causes, but reads it as a missing argument, not a flipped check.
